dynamic_version_audit.boundary: Framework and product behavior remains version-sensitive and requires periodic re-review; waived non-evidentiary records are excluded from the review-required denominator.

first_party_and_classic_source_audit.boundary: This closes the registered-source gap audit only; it does not claim permanent Internet completeness.

relation_preservation_audit.boundary: extends and compares are legacy source-audit relation labels, not graph edge types; their source-log records remain preserved. contains and implements are retained as controlled graph edges.

scope: Strict acceptance evidence for the 13-module bounded formal RAG release; no new external search.

single_conclusion_audit.method: Canonical graph label and chapter atom list were checked one-by-one; no label was split or silently merged. Conditions, implementations, comparisons and conflicts remain separate evidence or edges.

records.basis: one graph label maps to one bounded atom; compound conditions remain in related atoms and edges
